import json

with open('manifest.json') as f:
    m = json.load(f)

# Models
print('=== MODELS ===')
for k,v in m['nodes'].items():
    if v['resource_type'] == 'model':
        print(f\"{k} | mat={v['config'].get('materialized')} | relation={v.get('relation_name')} | unique_key={v['config'].get('unique_key')} | cluster_by={v['config'].get('cluster_by')} | deps={v.get('depends_on',{}).get('nodes',[])} | file={v.get('original_file_path')}\")

print()
print('=== SOURCES ===')
for k,v in m.get('sources',{}).items():
    print(f\"{k} | relation={v.get('relation_name')}\")

print()
print('=== TESTS ===')
for k,v in m['nodes'].items():
    if v['resource_type'] == 'test':
        print(f\"{k} | test_metadata={v.get('test_metadata',{}).get('name','?')} | deps={v.get('depends_on',{}).get('nodes',[])} | file={v.get('original_file_path')}\")

print()
print('=== EXPOSURES ===')
for k,v in m.get('exposures',{}).items():
    print(f\"{k} | deps={v.get('depends_on',{}).get('nodes',[])}\")

print()
print('=== CHILD MAP (first 30) ===')
cm = m.get('child_map',{})
for i,(k,v) in enumerate(cm.items()):
    if i >= 30: break
    print(f\"{k} -> {v}\")

print()
print('=== PYTHON MODELS ===')
for k,v in m['nodes'].items():
    if v['resource_type'] == 'model' and v.get('language') == 'python':
        print(f\"{k} | relation={v.get('relation_name')}\")
